name: @vssaros/dsh-browser
description: VsSaros browser (CDP) module for DeepSeek Harness: drives a real local Chrome over the DevTools protocol FROM THE HOST PROCESS, so the tool family keeps working when the Host runs without VsSaros. Ported from src/vs/sessions/contrib/agentStudio/{common/browserCdp.ts,common/chromeDebugSetup.ts,electron-main/browserCdpChannel.ts}. Deliberately declares no vssaros.module: it is standalone-only until the IDE-side path is retired (a second `browser` tool would collide).
